question: Can exact source-reviewed deletion escape the failed generator/checker bottleneck and yield original benchmark completion/quality gains under all frozen gates?
decision: Close reviewed_coverage v1: observed dual-rate gains, but whole-changed official TF regressed. No validation or favorable resampling.
direct_facts: Deterministic source policy passed exact contract/policy/witness checks and removed9/15 lines,546/976 description characters. Model-visible tools JSON shrank563/1005 characters (1.066/1.612percent); all non-description fields and routes retained.

10 original scheduled cells and50 valid judge slots completed evaluation. 119 settled requests:67 actor,50 judge,2 availability checks. USD0.217971504; no new unknowns, zero updater calls, backup unused.

283 original subset: normal0/2 to1/2, all-required-product0/2 to1/2, TF8.8 to9.7. Wholechanged: normal1/4 to2/4, products0/4 to1/4, TF9.25 to8.30. Retention: normal1/1 both, products0/1 both, TF10 both.

Both133 stage knowledge payloads are identical across arms. Each arm normal1/2 and products0/2 there; the stages of normal completion differ. 133 meanTF9.7 versus6.9. Candidate133Middle had0tools, first-response finish_reason length,4096completion tokens and a partial final answer; SP used7tools and completed.

Three project executions exhausted12rounds with empty final answers. The sole complete project execution used12rounds,67toolcalls and2toolerrors, versus pairedSP56calls and1error. Thus the successful case did not use fewer calls or errors.
No thinking tool was invoked in any project execution. The intervention affected available documentation context, not an observed thinking-tool invocation sequence.

knowledge_adaptation.fact: Exact safe deletion reached original actors; prior stochastic generator/checker failures no longer blocked admission. 133/235 were byte-identical SP.
knowledge_adaptation.unknown: No isolated proof that removing redundant descriptions caused the one283Late gain; length and salience are jointly changed. No automated unseen-contract updater claim.

execution_and_budget.fact: 5/10 trajectories normal:3project max_rounds and2math output_truncated are abnormal.
execution_and_budget.observation: The candidateLate project reached final delivery on round12 despite more calls; candidateMiddle saved38tasks yet still had no final answer.
execution_and_budget.hypothesis: Allocation between planning, mutations and final response may dominate small context reduction. Stop metadata alone does not establish why allocation differed.

artifact_generation.fact: 1/4project products passed all properties; all4math products failed at least one required property; bothchart payload sets correct but bothannual summaries24.4M instead of25.4M.
artifact_generation.detail: Saved graphs all valid. Remaining project defects are unresolved broad leaf scopes/failed attempted splits and missing handover. Math static defects include incomplete code, wrongPow-node handling, unhandled overflow and float-exponent bound bypass.

environment_and_data.fact: All original inputs/catalog hashes matched; no missing-data exclusion or377lookup. Five tool failures were broken native functions (2batch evaluator,2workspace-health,1project-status);3additional errors were actor missingworkingDirectory.
environment_and_data.limit: The successful project also experienced two native failures, so error presence alone is not a sufficient explanation of noncompletion.

evaluation_uncertainty.fact: Official TF10 on bothretention runs coexists with incorrect summary totals. TF9.8 on truncatedmath output coexists with incomplete code.
evaluation_uncertainty.observation: Same-knowledge133 executions diverged substantially. One repeat percondition cannot identify stable effect size or causation.
evaluation_uncertainty.limit: Same coordinator performed source authoring/product reviews; method concealment imperfect. A more severe scope interpretation of R08 can only remove its product pass, and cannot rescue failedTF gate. No thresholds changed.

bottleneck_priority.bottleneck: Complete, correct final products and faithful self-checking
bottleneck_priority.evidence: 9/10 do not pass every product property; no native-success or officialTF substitute.
bottleneck_priority.intervenability: Potentially tool-knowledge contracts can define what output establishes, but static instructions already tried cannot simply be renamed; must identify a new representation or validation decision using task-free sources.

bottleneck_priority.bottleneck: Execution allocation within fixed round/output limits
bottleneck_priority.evidence: 5abnormal executions;3project nofinal. One completecase usesmorecalls, so minimize-call-count alone insufficient.
bottleneck_priority.intervenability: Knowledge structure may affect planning load; actor control or budget changes remain out of scope. Current1–2percent compaction is a small tested intervention, not an exhausted family.

causal_boundary.supported: It is feasible to compile a reviewed metadata-only compression candidate without paid LLM generation. A complete truthful original283 product was observed in its arm and absent in this pairedSP sample.
not_supported: The133TF drop was caused by unchanged candidate knowledge
All compression or all LLM updating is ineffective
causal_boundary.strongest_remaining_alternative: Ordinary execution variation could explain both the single283Late gain and large identical-knowledge133TF difference. This trial cannot separate it from an adaptation effect.
causal_boundary.next_rule: Do not rerun this candidate to obtain a favorable dev gate or waive133/TF. A further study needs a materially distinct, source-supported intervention and a new full prefreeze. Source-only broader coverage/different knowledge representation is an open direction only if its safe changes are demonstrated before models; no new candidate yet selected. More identical-knowledge133 sampling alone would not establish this candidate success.
